points.description: Gives the correct final answer of 0.625 (5/8, 62.5%), obtained through a valid chain of reasoning with no incorrect step. For example: P(85→90) = 0.2/0.5 = 0.4 by conditioning on a 75-year-old reaching 85. Then P(80→85) = 0.25/0.4 = 0.625 since P(80→90) = P(80→85)·P(85→90). Equivalent correct methods earn the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark only if every step is valid and the final answer is 5/8 (0.625, 62.5%). Any wrong step or wrong final answer earns 0. Equivalent wording and correct alternative methods are accepted.
rubric.answer_key: Let q = P(85-year-old lives 5 more years). A 75-year-old who lives 15 more years must first reach 85 (probability 0.5), then live 5 more: 0.5·q = 0.2, so q = 0.4. An 80-year-old who lives 10 more years must live 5 more years (probability p) and then 5 more (q): p·0.4 = 0.25, so p = 0.625 = 5/8.
